newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Islamic Jihad calls for new revolt against Israel.
newsitem.headline: Islamic Jihad calls for new revolt against Israel.

text.p: The militant Islamic Jihad group on Wednesday called on Palestinians to rise up against Israel's settlement building in Arab East Jerusalem.

"At this critical stage when the Jewish state persists in its rabid settlement campaign in Jerusalem...we call on all forces of our struggling people to rise for the defence of Jerusalem," the group said in a leaflet distributed in the West Bank and Gaza Strip.

Invoking the uprising which began in 1987 and tapered off after the 1993 Israeli-PLO self-rule deal, the group said: "Oh heroes of the intifada: teach this enemy a lesson that Jerusalem is ours and that we do not abandon one grain of its earth."
Israel inflamed Palestinian feelings on Tuesday when it broke ground for the construction of a 6,500 housing unit settlement on the southern outskirts of Arab East Jerusalem.

But only small and mostly peaceful protests confronted the Israeli bulldozers which began opening roads on the pine tree-covered hill which Palestinians call Jabal Abu Ghneim and Israelis call Har Homa.

The Islamic militant Hamas group said that the start of Israeli construction was a "declaration of a new war" on Palestinians and called for a comprehensive Palestinian programme to confront Israeli settlement plans.

Hamas and Islamic Jihad, which oppose Israeli-PLO peace moves, accused Palestinian President Yasser Arafat's Authority of preventing Palestinians from taking to the streets to protest against the Israeli settlement plans.
